metrics.name: Agent Backups Without Screenshot Verification
metrics.gotcha: !isArchived uses boolean negation here — confirming isArchived is stored as boolean on the Assets[] objects. The older metrics (ids 757, 759, 760) use string or boolean comparisons inconsistently; this id=2079 form uses boolean. Use the boolean form for any new/proposed metrics.

metrics.name: Recent Backup Failures (Most Recent Job)
metrics.gotcha: isArchived is tested as string 'true' in the Global metric (isArchived != `true`), not boolean. backups[0] references the most recent backup job entry. Both assumptions are baked into the Global metric query.

metrics.name: Assets With No Successful Backup in 30+ Days
Backups Not Completed in Last 24 Hours Count
metrics.gotcha: HoursSinceLastSuccessfulBackup_r is a Liongard-computed (_r suffix) field, not a native Datto field. A value of 99999 means 'never backed up' or data unavailable — exclude it to avoid counting unprovisioned slots. isArchived is boolean false here (compare with id=757 which uses the string 'true').

metrics.name: Backups Not Completed in Last 24 Hours Summary
metrics.jmesPathQuery: Assets[?isArchived == `false` && HoursSinceLastSuccessfulBackup_r != `99999` && HoursSinceLastSuccessfulBackup_r > `24`].[name,  join(' ',['Latest Successful Backup:' ,latestSuccessfulBackup_r])][] | join (' | ', @)

metrics.name: Days Until Service Expiration
metrics.gotcha: NumDaysTillServiceExpiration_r uses the _r suffix — this is a Liongard-computed derived field, not a raw Datto API field.
